packageRules.description: Take a PyPI release only once it is three days old, so one that is yanked or found to be malicious never reaches a pull request.
ruff runs from the dev extra in CI and from the commit hook. One pull request moves both, so the two never disagree about formatting.
mypy runs from the dev extra in CI and from the commit hook. One pull request moves both, so the two never disagree about types.
Pyright runs from the dev extra in CI and from the commit hook. One pull request moves both, so the two never disagree about types.
Say what a failing check means on a regex update.
prBodyNotes: If `tests/test_unicode_data.py` fails on this pull request, the new release carries a newer Unicode version. The failure prints the table to paste into `src/heckler/characters.py`.
